messages.text: Vertex checkout 500s are back on a smaller set of cards.
Tom owns the incident while Priya keeps the customer update thread clean.
Root cause looked like the 3DS callback, and I deployed the first fix.
Verification failed; the error rate dipped, then spiked again.
I found the second cause in the merchant cache and deployed the corrected fix.
Verification passes now and the incident is resolved.
